title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
statement_short: Given an array of stock prices where prices[i] is the price on the i-th day, find the maximum profit from buying on one day and selling on a future day. Return 0 if no profit can be achieved.
hint: Array size up to 10^5 requires an O(n) time solution by maintaining the lowest price seen so far in a single pass.
keywords: buying on one day and selling on a future day
why_not: Right: Greedy tracks the minimum buying price seen so far and updates maximum profit at each day in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not 2D DP: Maintaining a full state matrix is redundant for a single buy-sell transaction. Not Two Pointers: Scanning inward from both ends misses peak profit points occurring within inner subsegments. Not Monotonic Stack: Maintaining a monotonic price stack consumes unnecessary O(n) extra space.
